plan.title: bug(work): PAN-1700 agent committed .pan/specs/*.vbrief.json mutations — PAN-1124 immutability violated on feature branch
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Specs in .pan/specs/ are committed on the feature branch, so a work agent can edit its own acceptance criteria or item statuses and the edit rides the merge to main (PAN-1700 commit d897ca1f4). docs/XBRIEF.md declares the spec immutable after planning except for lifecycle status and explicit re-planning, but nothing enforces it and roles/work.md never forbids it.
narratives.Proposal: Add a required plan-integrity verification check, run after test-skip and before the quality gates, that compares the issue's spec at HEAD with a reference copy and fails on any change outside top-level status, plan.status, plan.updated, plan.sequence and xBRIEFInfo.updated, naming each changed item id and the git restore remediation. The reference is the newest finalize commit carrying a verified Plan-Finalized: <sha256> trailer (written by planning finalize in the repo that holds the spec), then a legacy finalize-subject commit, then the merge-base copy, then the commit that first added the spec. Legitimate re-plans pass because they move the reference. The work role forbids spec edits and trailers, and PIPELINE-GATES.md and XBRIEF.md document the gate. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-1728.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No stored state: no record, DB row or journal field for the reference; it is derived from git each run
- No forgery resistance beyond the trailer hash check; an agent deliberately writing a trailer is out of scope
- No one-off audit script for in-flight branches
- No change to how pan start commits its status transition (PAN-4225); only the XBRIEF.md sentence is corrected
- No change to .pan/continues/, pan task, vbrief-conflicts or vbrief-ac behavior
- No review-convoy prompt changes; #4348 reuses resolvePlanReference separately

autoDecisions.summary: Follow the operator-approved design in the 2026-09-29 issue comment (plan-integrity check, Plan-Finalized trailer, merge-base fallback) instead of the original 'things to check' list.
autoDecisions.rationale: The comment states it replaces that list and was approved on 2026-09-28.

autoDecisions.summary: Extend the reference chain with a legacy finalize-subject marker and a first-commit-that-added-the-spec fallback after the merge-base copy.
autoDecisions.rationale: Specs are added on the feature branch, so in-flight branches and pan start --auto specs have no trailer and no merge-base copy; without these fallbacks the gate would either skip them or false-fail re-planned branches their agents cannot fix.

autoDecisions.summary: The trailer value is SHA-256 over the spec's exact committed bytes and the gate verifies it; a mismatched trailer is ignored and reported.
autoDecisions.rationale: Gives the design's '<sha256>' a checkable meaning; forgery resistance is explicitly out of scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep polyrepo in scope: finalize commits the trailer in the repo that holds the spec, and the gate runs in resolvePlanHome(workspacePath).
autoDecisions.rationale: The design requires the check to run in the plan home, and today's wrapper finalize commit never contains a polyrepo spec.

autoDecisions.summary: A HEAD spec with merge-conflict markers passes plan-integrity with evidence and is left to the existing vbrief-conflicts check.
autoDecisions.rationale: plan-integrity runs first; failing it would replace vbrief-conflicts' specific resolution instructions with generic feedback.

autoDecisions.summary: Fail closed on git errors inside a valid plan-home work tree; pass with evidence when the plan home is not a git work tree or no spec exists.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the test-skip gate (PR #3872 finding 4) and keeps existing runner tests on non-git temp dirs unaffected.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the remediation (git restore --source=<ref> -- <spec>, pan task done, ask for re-planning) in the gate evidence.
autoDecisions.rationale: The shared failure feedback says 'fix the code', which does not tell an agent how to undo a spec edit.

autoDecisions.summary: No one-off audit of in-flight branches.
autoDecisions.rationale: The gate checks every branch at its next verification, which covers the issue's old check #3.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 (steps 1-8) and decisions D1, D2, D5, D6, D7, D8. Create src/lib/cloister/plan-integrity-run.ts mirroring src/lib/cloister/test-skip-run.ts. Export resolvePlanReference(planHome, issueId, baseRef) (a named export #4348 will reuse) and evaluatePlanIntegrityGate(issueId, workspacePath, roots) returning {failed, evidence, error?}. Use promisified execFile only (no execSync; server-reachable). Plan home = resolvePlanHome(workspacePath); target branch from the root whose realpath equals the plan home, else roots[0].targetBranch, else 'main'. Reference chain: newest commit in mergeBase..HEAD with a Plan-Finalized trailer whose value equals planFinalizedHash of the issue's spec blob at that commit (mismatch -> evidence note, keep searching) -> newest legacy finalize subject commit touching the issue spec -> merge-base copy -> first commit on the branch that added an issue spec. Pass with evidence when the plan home is not a git work tree, when there is no spec at HEAD and no reference, or when the HEAD spec has conflict markers (vbrief-conflicts owns those). Fail closed when a git command fails inside a valid work tree. Compare spec filename sets, then diffPlanDocuments per same-named pair. Evidence starts with 'reference: <kind> <sha8>', lists one line per violation naming item ids, and on failure appends the remediation: git restore --source=<refSha> -- <specPath>, commit, record completion with pan task done, and ask for re-planning (pan plan <ISSUE>) if the plan itself is wrong. Tests use real temp git repos with a bare origin and resolvePlanHome mocked; cover every case listed in the PRD.

metadata.sizeJustification: One protocol with a writer and a reader: planning finalize writes the Plan-Finalized trailer and the verification gate reads it. Splitting them into sibling issues would ship a trailer nobody checks or a gate whose reference never exists, so neither half is independently useful. The 16 files are small new modules, their tests, one allowlist row, one role paragraph and two doc sections; the subsystem count is inflated by tests/, scripts/, roles/, docs/ and .overdeck/ each counting as a subsystem.
